scope: Successful independent fixture conversion, load and execution measurements; no real-model performance claim

fixture.profile: one-layer Llama, width 4, GQA, RoPE and nonzero MLP, 260-token SentencePiece vocabulary

budgets.conversion: ConversionOptions defaults except max_block_terms=1024, max_output_bytes=1073741824 and max_cache_bytes=1048576; full resolved options retained in conversion.stdout
budgets.generation: prompt AB, greedy temperature 0, two sampled tokens, KV context 8

execution_process.execution_scope: KV allocation, lazy symbolic-kernel compilation, prompt prefill, two greedy samples and one intermediate cached forward; no unused forward after last sample
execution_process.rss_scope: Full process lifetime including loading/setup, not isolated execution-only RSS

measurement.wall: Python time.monotonic_ns around each separate subprocess
measurement.phase_timers: Rust Instant; excludes process startup and measured separately from loading/tokenization
measurement.memory: Linux os.wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB for each child lifetime, including launch/exec overhead; identical high-water values do not establish identical phase working sets
measurement.cache_state: Uncontrolled OS page cache; hashing and preceding phases can warm pages
measurement.timing_interpretation: One observed sample; wall, CPU and internal phase timers have different scopes and are not interchangeable

limitations: Fixture values are highly repetitive and simple; its output size ratio is not evidence of real-model compression.
No statistical throughput, cold-cache or steady-state performance claim.
RSS is process high-water memory, not a measured execution-only allocation peak or the converter's accounted memory budget.
Real-model attempts remain failures documented separately; this fixture does not supersede them.
